status: APPROVED by the user 2026-10-29 20:10; frozen before any test-dev number; reporting rules fixed with the approval
reporting_rules: Pre-registered verdicts E-H1-E-H4 are defined on val and stay as computed (runs/ext/e4/e4.json). On test-dev they are evaluated exactly the same way (same definitions, heads/branches, paired bootstrap CIs, Holm, '>= 4 of 5' with the conservative reading of untestable cases) as held-out confirmation, reported next to the val verdicts.
Every frozen row is reported, regardless of outcome. No retuning, no re-selection, no added rows after seeing test-dev numbers.
Primary protocol visdrone_ignore (toolkit port, cap 500 detections per image); plain as a secondary column.
Consistency table val vs. test-dev per row: AP, rank, and whether each verdict holds.
Size bins prominently (AP and AP50, incl. < 8 px and 8-16 px; test-dev has 13 % of its GT < 8 px).
Exploratory rows (X-grid, decomposition B, R3 compute control) in separate tables, labelled post hoc, never counted toward a verdict.
Descriptive on test-dev: crowded vs. isolated recall for A, B, C (F2) and the X-grid rows; dup / frag rates.
not_frozen_again: R, R2, M_ab, X2: configs/final/frozen_rows.json (test-dev done 2026-10-24)
